requirements.requirement: The system must render a prescription behavior module within MessageBubble when prescription behavior data is present in the provider scorecard payload.
The system must display a relevance indicator derived from transformed data provided by EVAL-P-RX-UX-S2.
The system must visually distinguish relevance levels using consistent UI states (e.g., high, medium, low).
The system must render a list of top relevant drugs with names and ordering as provided by the transformation layer.
The system must limit displayed drugs to the top N entries as defined in the frontend data contract.
The system must display an integrity indicator showing either 'clean' or 'flagged' based on transformed data.
The system must visually differentiate integrity states using distinct UI cues (e.g., icon, color, or label).
The system must display the prescription behavior contribution to the overall provider score as a numeric or percentage value.
The system must ensure the prescription behavior module is rendered in the correct position within the provider scorecard layout inside MessageBubble.
The system must reuse existing MessageBubble styling and layout patterns to maintain visual consistency with other scorecard modules.
The system must not render the prescription behavior module if the prescription data object is absent or null.
The system must render a fallback state (e.g., 'No prescription data available') when the data object exists but contains no usable values.
The system must handle malformed prescription data gracefully without breaking MessageBubble rendering.
The system must render all prescription behavior fields using only transformed frontend data and must not perform additional business logic inside MessageBubble.
The system must support conditional rendering of each subcomponent (relevance, drugs, integrity, score contribution) independently based on field availability.
The system must ensure the prescription behavior module renders within acceptable performance bounds (<100ms additional render time).
The system must ensure accessibility by providing text labels for all visual indicators (relevance and integrity).
The system must ensure that rendering the prescription module does not alter or regress existing MessageBubble components.
